nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The salon is a constellation of glassware and careful laughs. Maris Quell stands near a tall window, dry humour already loaded.

choices.text: Not yet — back to the foyer.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: You're the trade liaison. Orth, yes? You look like someone who rehearsed this doorway.

faculty_interjections.text: She clocked the rehearsal. Abort? No. Recover.
Own it. Honesty as cover. Rare and effective.

choices.text: I did. Doorways are structurally important.
Only the freight schedules. Everything else is improvisation.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Structurally important. I'll steal that. Observatory Circle lives on doorways — who enters, who leaves, who pretends not to listen.

faculty_interjections.text: She's funny. That's not in the brief. Update the brief.

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: If you're hunting policy rather than canapés, Voss holds court on the terrace later. The study annex is locked to everyone but people who look harmless. You look… almost harmless.

effects.summary: Maris: Voss on terrace later; study for the harmless-looking.

choices.text: Almost is my brand. Thank you.
Harmless enough to ask who keeps the annex key?

nodes.speaker: maris_quell
nodes.text: Clerk Moth. He treats keys like scripture. I'd bring a better excuse than curiosity.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Across the room: Lord Edrin Voss, collecting people like porcelain. He hasn't noticed you. Yet.

faculty_interjections.text: Do not stare. Stare adjacent. Collect silhouette.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You step back toward the foyer before the room invents a role for you.
